name: Yamaha MT-07 / Tracer 7 (2018 on)
engine: 689 cc liquid-cooled CP2 parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: The updated MT-07 and its touring sibling. Some 2018 bikes had a chain guard bolt recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2018 MT-07s are in recall 18V483 for chain guard mounting bolts that can loosen.

recalls.what: Chain guard mounting bolts can loosen from vibration.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces both chain guard bolts free.

forums.what: Owner forum for the Yamaha MT-07, FZ-07 and their relatives.
